question: Bharat ka kshetrafal kitna hai aur duniya me sthan kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Bharat ka kshetrafal 32,87,263 sq km hai aur duniya me iska 7th sthan hai. | Galat kyun: Baaki teenon vikalpon me kshetrafal aur sthan donon galat hain. | Concept: Desh ka kshetrafal ↔ vishva me sthan. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 32,87,263 — '32' se shuru, 7th sthan. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Bharat ka standard time kis deshantar par aadharit hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — IST 82°30′ E deshantar par aadharit hai (Mirzapur, UP); IST = GMT + 5:30. | Galat kyun: 77°30′ E Delhi ke paas hai, 72°30′ E aur 87°30′ E Bharat ke manak deshantar nahi hain. | Concept: Manak samay = ek kendriya deshantar se tay hota hai. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: IST = 82°30′ E, Mirzapur. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Kark Rekha (Tropic of Cancer) kin rajyon se nahi guzarti?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Kark Rekha 8 rajyon se guzarti hai: Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram — Bihar inme nahi hai. | Galat kyun: Gujarat, Rajasthan aur MP teeno Kark Rekha par hain, isliye ve 'nahi guzarti' ka uttar nahi ho sakte. | Concept: Kark Rekha (23.5°N) ↔ 8 rajya. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 8 rajya — Gujarat se Mizoram tak; Bihar nahi. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Bharat ki sabse unchi choti kaun si hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bharat ki sabse unchi choti Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) hai; Everest Nepal me hai. | Galat kyun: Everest Bharat ki nahi, Nepal ki choti hai; Anai Mudi Western Ghats ki sabse unchi hai; Nanda Devi Uttarakhand ki unchi choti hai, lekin Kangchenjunga se chhoti. | Concept: Desh ki sabse unchi choti ≠ duniya ki sabse unchi choti. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kangchenjunga = Bharat ki chhat (8,586 m); Everest = Nepal. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 2.

question: Godavari nadi ko kya kaha jata hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Godavari ko 'Dakshin Ganga' kaha jata hai; yah dakshin Bharat ki sabse lambi pra-dweepiya nadi hai. | Galat kyun: 'Ganga ki beti', 'Pashchim Ganga' aur 'Uttar Ganga' Godavari ke upnaam nahi hain. | Concept: Nadi ↔ upnaam ↔ kshetra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Godavari = Dakshin ki Ganga. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Kaun si nadiyan purab se pashchim ki ore behti hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Narmada aur Tapti purab se pashchim behti hain (rift valley se) aur Arabian Sea me girti hain. | Galat kyun: Kaveri, Mahanadi, Godavari, Krishna, Ganga aur Yamuna pashchim se purab behkar Bay of Bengal me girti hain. | Concept: Rift valley wali nadiyan ulta behti hain — purab se pashchim. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Narmada-Tapti = ulta behna (rift valley). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Bharat me sabse zyada varsha kahan hoti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Mawsynram (Meghalaya) me Bharat me sabse zyada varsha hoti hai; Cherrapunji bhi paas me hai. | Galat kyun: Shimla, Ooty aur Darjeeling pahadi sthan hain, lekin varsha me Mawsynram se bahut peeche hain. | Concept: Varsha = mansoon + pahadi dhalaan (orographic rainfall). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Mawsynram = sabse zyada varsha (Meghalaya). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 4.

question: Kali mitti (Regur) kis fasal ke liye upyukt hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Kali mitti (Regur, Deccan) kapas ke liye sabse upyukt hai; isme nami rokne ki kshamata hoti hai. | Galat kyun: Ganna aur chawal jalodh mitti me, gehun jalodh/kali donon me hota hai — lekin kapas ke liye kali mitti sabse prasiddh hai. | Concept: Mitti ↔ fasal ka joda. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Kali mitti = kapas (Regur = Deccan). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 1.

question: Hari Kranti ke janak kaun mane jate hain?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: B — Bharat me Hari Kranti ke janak M.S. Swaminathan mane jate hain (1960s, gehu-chawal, Punjab-Haryana-UP). | Galat kyun: C.V. Raman bhautiki (Raman effect), Hargobind Khorana jeev-vigyan, Verghese Kurien Shwet Kranti (doodh) se jude hain. | Concept: Kranti ↔ uske janak. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Hari Kranti = Swaminathan; Shwet Kranti = Kurien. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 4.

question: Bharat ka sabse lamba National Highway kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — NH-44 (Srinagar–Kanyakumari, ~3,745 km) Bharat ka sabse lamba National Highway hai. | Galat kyun: NH-19, NH-27 aur NH-48 lambe rajmark hain, lekin NH-44 se chhote hain. | Concept: Sabse lamba NH = desh ke uttar se dakshin tak. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: NH-44 = Srinagar se Kanyakumari (poora desh). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NHAI.

question: Bharat me pehli rail kab aur kahan chali?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Bharat me pehli rail 1853 me Mumbai se Thane ke beech chali. | Galat kyun: 1857, 1860 aur 1850 galat varsh hain; Delhi–Kolkata aur Chennai–Bengaluru pehli rail ke marg nahi the. | Concept: Pehli rail ↔ varsh ↔ marg. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 1853 = Mumbai–Thane (pehli rail). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 7.

question: Jharkhand ka Jharia kis khanij ke liye prasiddh hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Jharkhand ka Jharia Bharat ka sabse bada koyla kshetra hai. | Galat kyun: Loha, petroleum aur bauxite Jharia ki pehchan nahi hain. | Concept: Khanij kshetra ↔ khanij. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Jharia = koyla (Jharkhand). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 5.

question: Census 2011 ke anusar Bharat ki jansankhya kitni thi?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: C — Census 2011 ke anusar Bharat ki jansankhya 121.08 crore thi; sex ratio 943 aur saksharta 73% thi. | Galat kyun: 102.8 crore 2001 ka aankda hai; 130.5 aur 115.2 crore 2011 ke nahi hain. | Concept: Census 2011 hi abhi tak ka aakhri pura census hai (2021 deferred). | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 121.08 crore — 2011. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; Census of India 2011.

question: Census 2011 ke anusar Bharat ka sex ratio kitna tha?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Census 2011 me Bharat ka sex ratio 943 tha (prati 1,000 purush par 943 mahilayein). | Galat kyun: 933 (2001 ka), 940 aur 927 galat aankde hain. | Concept: Sex ratio = prati 1,000 purush par mahilayein. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 943 — 2011. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; Census of India 2011.

question: Bharat me kitne Rajya aur Kendrashasit Pradesh hain (2026)?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — 2026 tak Bharat me 28 Rajya aur 8 Kendrashasit Pradesh hain. | Galat kyun: 27/9, 30/6 aur 29/7 purane ya galat vibhajan hain (J&K punargathan 2019 ke baad 28/8). | Concept: Rajya/UT ki sankhya samay ke saath badalti hai — vartaman sankhya yaad rakho. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: 28 + 8 = 36 (2026). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md.

question: Western Ghats ki sabse unchi choti kaun si hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Anai Mudi (2,695 m) Western Ghats ki sabse unchi choti hai. | Galat kyun: Doddabetta Nilgiri ki sabse unchi choti hai (Western Ghats ki nahi); Nilgiri ek shrinkhala hai, choti nahi; Mahabaleshwar ek sthan hai. | Concept: Shrinkhala ↔ uski sabse unchi choti. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Anai Mudi = Western Ghats ki chhat; Doddabetta = Nilgiri ki chhat. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 2.

question: Brahmaputra nadi ka udgam kahan hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — Brahmaputra ka udgam Mansarovar (Tibet) ke paas hai. | Galat kyun: Amarkantak Narmada ka, Yamunotri Yamuna ka, Gangotri Ganga ka udgam hai. | Concept: Nadi ↔ udgam. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Brahmaputra = Tibet (Mansarovar) se aati hai. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 3.

question: Bharat ka ekmatra bada marusthal kaun sa hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Thar Marusthal (Rajasthan) Bharat ka ekmatra bada marusthal hai. | Galat kyun: Gobi (Mongolia/China), Sahara (Africa) Bharat me nahi hain; Kutch rann hai, marusthal nahi. | Concept: Marusthal ↔ desh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Thar = Bharat ka ekmatra marusthal. | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 9 Geography Ch. 2.

question: Digboi kis liye prasiddh hai?
option_a: Bharat ki sabse purani tel refinery
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: A — Digboi (Assam) Bharat ki sabse purani tel refinery/kshetra hai. | Galat kyun: Digboi bandargah, koyla kshetra ya bandh nahi hai. | Concept: Sabse purana ↔ kshetra. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: Digboi = Assam ka tel (sabse purana). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; NCERT Class 10 Geography Ch. 5.

question: PM-KISAN ke tahat kisan ko varsh me kitni rashi milti hai?
option_e: Unattempted — mark E only if deliberately leaving this question blank
explanation: Sahi: D — PM-KISAN (2019) ke tahat kisan ko ₹6,000/varsh milte hain. | Galat kyun: ₹12,000, ₹4,000 aur ₹8,000 yojana ki rashi nahi hain. | Concept: Yojana ↔ rashi ↔ varsh. | Yaad rakhne ke liye: PM-KISAN = 6,000/varsh (2019). | Source: notes/03_geography_india.md; pmkisan.gov.in.
